text: Woke up sobbing and my bf almost stayed home but I told him to go. I am so fucked up. I tried to reach out for help from someone yesterday and I am not even joking, it was a fucking tranny, and when I didn't want to talk to a pervert freakazoid (I was nice about it) he reported me to discord so I couldn't talk to my girlfriends for a day. I'm unbanned now as I obviously didn't do anything wrong but what a fucking freak. Imagine preying on someone who is in a bad spot. My family is so fucking gay. I need to just make peace with it. Nothing anyone can tell me will make them more tolerable. It's just the cards I was dealt. It will all be ok. I think I will insist on a fourth of july party across state and we can visit the giant root beer barrel. I need something to look forward to
